description:
Configure a new external laboratory provider in LibreHealth EHR. 

Log in as 'admin' with password 'password'. 

Navigate to the 'Practice' settings in the Administration menu and find the 'Procedure Providers' section. 

Add a new provider with the following configuration:
- Name: LabCorp Diagnostics
- NPI: 1234567893
- Sending Application ID: LIBREEHR
- Sending Facility ID: CLINIC01
- Receiving Application ID: LABCORP
- Receiving Facility ID: LC7890
- Protocol: DL (or Download/File)
- Remote Host: sftp.labcorp-example.com
- Results/Orders Path: /home/results
- Ensure the provider is set to Active.
- Select 'Dr. Sarah Chen' (or the first available physician) as the Lab Director if prompted.

Save the configuration.
